title: settling-local-constancy
description: A sheaf on the bitopological settling site that, beyond a settling-bound ordinal, stops contributing new content along the settling axis - every temporal-advance restriction past that bound is an isomorphism, forcing stabilization of settling cohomology. A local-constancy refinement of a sheaf generated by recording where the settling has quiesced.

stabilizationBound.description: the ordinal tau_0 beyond which the sheaf carries no further settling content

settlingLocallyConstant.description: for every tau >= tau_0 and every temporal-advance morphism h : tau -> tau' in lambda^op, the restriction F(id x h*) : F(q, tau', U) -> F(q, tau, U) is an isomorphism
